purpose: Shared source snapshot and publication assignments for six report-only product fidelity reviews; not a release manifest, installed receipt or new Wayfinder.
snapshot_standing: GitHub main refs independently resolved during this preparation; not evidence that their composition or the Mac installation has been tested

EpiLogos/O-I.role: shared CLI, installation, settings, desktop/application and cross-product consumer inspection

EpiLogos/QL-MEF.review_access: read-only; no source, ledger, matrix, M/M-prime, install or configuration mutation

installed_candidate.standing: The owner's scoped non-QL Mac cut is running; its exact published receipt must be read before making installed-cut claims.
installed_candidate.policy: Preserve R0. Each reviewer records later selected cuts/pushed branch heads separately and rechecks relevant findings. The collator freezes the actual returned target in TARGET-CUT.json and reconciles deltas before issuing repairs. A main snapshot is not an installed receipt.

ui_consumer.destination: owner's approved parallel/new UI under O-I#375
ui_consumer.policy: Read latest substantive owner amendments and actual accessible pushed sources. Record old/donor, desired/new, integrated and installed versions separately. Local-only work is not accessible by assumption; do not infer that unavailable UI code is absent from the project. No UI merge or modification is authorised.

reviewers.shared_seams: O:I source/Project bindings, common Library source return, workspace-to-source continuity, root/Project settings and temporal source
O:I chat/Agency receivers, request/stream/result/permission state, Gateway and execution authority
O:I operative front door, TUI, Search/Library, configuration contribution controller, harness setup and companions
O:I Factory UI/read models, Run/Agents/Context, native Day/NOW return, feature-line worktree and development lifecycle
O:I managed install/update, artifact/receipt/launcher and machine settings, remote/sandbox/service lifecycle and hosting
O:I Expression/Techne/Epi consumers, corpus/world context, published Library/WorldPresentation and protected formal contracts

mutation_policy: Only assigned review artifacts in this directory may be added or amended. Reports may be published/merged to O-I main through normal checks. No production code/config, other docs/Skills, issue state, live services, remote feature branches or QL source changes.
evidence_standing: Report publication is not product acceptance, human ratification or authority to implement a suggested design.
worktree_policy: One reusable worktree per coherent feature line, not per reviewer/agent/session. Report-only connector publication needs no local worktree. Shared-branch writes and merges are serialized and current file SHAs reread on conflict.
